about: Neutral-region mobs (W-12). Each `sheet` is a soldier-format sheet class in src/assets/sheets/<sheet>/ (docs/v5/art/SHEET_FORMAT.md): rows south-east, north-east, south-west, north-west; anims idle, walk, run, attack, hit, die (ibex: no attack). True scale at the soldier's 33 px/m (W-18), same manifest scale 0.55. Prompts: docs/playbook/PROMPTS_ART.md › Mobs.

bandit.note: its own outfit (hooded mud-brown cloak, face wrap, leather scraps, short sword) on the militia base: every soldier clip (thrust, fallFwd, fallBack, ...)

jackal.note: the wolf's frames, smaller and tinted sandy
